<?php
/**
 * Payment Processing CLI Tool
 * Handles cross-service payment verification and settlement
 */

class HMACAuthenticator {
    private string $sharedSecret;
    
    public function __construct(string $secret) {
        $this->sharedSecret = $secret;
    }
    
    public function generateSignature(array $payload): string {
        $canonical = $this->canonicalize($payload);
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $canonical, $this->sharedSecret);
    }
    
    public function verifySignature(array $payload, string $signature): bool {
        $expected = $this->generateSignature($payload);
        return hash_equals($expected, $signature);
    }
    
    private function canonicalize(array $data): string {
        ksort($data);
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if ($key === 'signature') continue;
            $parts[] = $key . '=' . (string)$value;
        }
        return implode('&', $parts);
    }
}

class PaymentLedger {
    private array $transactions = [];
    private string $dbPath;
    
    public function __construct(string $dbPath) {
        $this->dbPath = $dbPath;
        if (file_exists($dbPath)) {
            $this->transactions = json_decode(file_get_contents($dbPath), true) ?? [];
        }
    }
    
    public function recordTransaction(string $txId, float $amount, string $status): void {
        $this->transactions[$txId] = [
            'amount' => $amount,
            'status' => $status,
            'timestamp' => time()
        ];
        $this->persist();
    }
    
    public function getTransaction(string $txId): ?array {
        return $this->transactions[$txId] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function isProcessed(string $txId): bool {
        $tx = $this->getTransaction($txId);
        return $tx !== null && $tx['status'] === 'settled';
    }
    
    private function persist(): void {
        file_put_contents($this->dbPath, json_encode($this->transactions), LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private HMACAuthenticator $auth;
    private PaymentLedger $ledger;
    private float $merchantBalance = 0.0;
    
    public function __construct(HMACAuthenticator $auth, PaymentLedger $ledger) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->ledger = $ledger;
    }
    
    public function processSettlement(array $request): array {
        // Step 1: Verify HMAC signature from payment gateway
        $signature = $request['signature'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->auth->verifySignature($request, $signature)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid signature', 'code' => 401];
        }
        
        // Step 2: Extract and validate payment details
        $txId = $request['transaction_id'] ?? '';
        $amount = $request['amount'] ?? 0;
        $currency = $request['currency'] ?? 'USD';
        
        if (empty($txId) || $amount <= 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid payment details', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        // Step 3: Check for duplicate processing
        if ($this->ledger->isProcessed($txId)) {
            return ['error' => 'Transaction already settled', 'code' => 409];
        }
        
        // Step 4: Apply currency conversion and settle
        $settledAmount = $this->convertAndSettle($amount, $currency);
        
        // Step 5: Record in ledger
        $this->ledger->recordTransaction($txId, $settledAmount, 'settled');
        $this->merchantBalance += $settledAmount;
        
        return [
            'status' => 'success',
            'settled_amount' => $settledAmount,
            'balance' => $this->merchantBalance
        ];
    }
    
    private function convertAndSettle(float $amount, string $currency): float {
        $rates = [
            'USD' => 1.0,
            'EUR' => 1.08,
            'GBP' => 1.27,
            'JPY' => 0.0067
        ];
        
        $rate = $rates[$currency] ?? 1.0;
        return round($amount * $rate, 2);
    }
    
    public function processRefund(array $request): array {
        $signature = $request['signature'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->auth->verifySignature($request, $signature)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid signature', 'code' => 401];
        }
        
        $txId = $request['transaction_id'] ?? '';
        $refundAmount = $request['amount'] ?? 0;
        
        $originalTx = $this->ledger->getTransaction($txId);
        if ($originalTx === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Original transaction not found', 'code' => 404];
        }
        
        // Verify refund doesn't exceed original amount
        if ($refundAmount > $originalTx['amount']) {
            return ['error' => 'Refund exceeds original amount', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        $refundTxId = 'R-' . $txId;
        $this->ledger->recordTransaction($refundTxId, -$refundAmount, 'settled');
        $this->merchantBalance -= $refundAmount;
        
        return [
            'status' => 'refunded',
            'refund_amount' => $refundAmount,
            'balance' => $this->merchantBalance
        ];
    }
    
    public function getBalance(): float {
        return $this->merchantBalance;
    }
}

// CLI Entry Point
function main(array $argv): void {
    $secret = getenv('PAYMENT_HMAC_SECRET') ?: 'default-dev-secret-change-in-prod';
    $dbPath = getenv('LEDGER_DB_PATH') ?: '/tmp/payment_ledger.json';
    
    $auth = new HMACAuthenticator($secret);
    $ledger = new PaymentLedger($dbPath);
    $processor = new PaymentProcessor($auth, $ledger);
    
    if (count($argv) < 2) {
        echo "Usage: php payment.php <settle|refund|balance> [json_payload]\n";
        exit(1);
    }
    
    $command = $argv[1];
    
    switch ($command) {
        case 'settle':
            $payload = json_decode($argv[2] ?? '{}', true);
            $result = $processor->processSettlement($payload);
            echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n";
            break;
            
        case 'refund':
            $payload = json_decode($argv[2] ?? '{}', true);
            $result = $processor->processRefund($payload);
            echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n";
            break;
            
        case 'balance':
            echo json_encode(['balance' => $processor->getBalance()]) . "\n";
            break;
            
        default:
            echo "Unknown command: $command\n";
            exit(1);
    }
}

main($argv);
